//: This is the web page. It is written in TypeScript without a framework,
built into plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript by Vite, and served by Nginx.
Commands (run from this folder, or from the root with 'npm run <name> --prefix ui'):
npm run dev        start the page on http://localhost:5173, reloading on every change
(it passes /api requests on to the API on your machine)
npm run build      check the types, then build the page into dist/
npm run preview    serve the built page from dist/, to try the build
npm test           run the automated tests once
npm run typecheck  check the types without building
name: animal-picture-ui
description: Web page that shows the latest animal picture and fetches new random ones through the animal-picture-api.
